decision_notes: Constitution Article III establishes the Senate and House as the legislature; sections 16-19 address executive organisation, bills, budget measures and enactment. The Senate is a legislative chamber, not a local council. Evidence: https://bvirtualogp.pr.gov/ogp/Bvirtual/leyesreferencia/PDF/Derechos%20Civiles/CONST/CONST.pdf

United States territory with its own constitutional bicameral legislature. This record covers the Senate, including its linked public joint-committee event; the House viewing service is not claimed validated.

The Senate official Eventos en Vivo index designates Vimeo plenary and public hearing services. Both sampled players decoded at 1280x720 with advancing time. The committee event is labelled 21 October 2026. The reusable plenary event changes title and date between the official index and player; do not treat the current title as a reliable programme timestamp or new-event identity.
Identity, playback, rights and surface reconciliation: reports/discovery/2026-10-22-territorial-followup-decisions.json
